summary: Robot News announced the 4th Robot Love Photo Contest, inviting submissions from August 1 to September 30, 2026, of photos showing happy or appealing moments of people with robots. title: 딥엑스, KT·세솔과 국산 NPU 기반 '온디바이스 AIoT 사업' 협력
summary: DeepX signed a three-way MOU with KT and Sesol to commercialize on-device AIoT systems built around DeepX’s domestic NPU chips. The collaboration targets edge environments such as industrial cameras, robots, smart-city systems, and traffic infrastructure, including AI edge boxes for real-time data processing and vision-based monitoring at EV charging stations and mobile CCTV sites.

title: 中 유니트리, IPO 일정 확정...8월 10일 청약 개시
summary: Unitree has set the subscription start date for its STAR Market IPO at August 10, with CITIC Securities as the underwriter. The company plans to issue 40,446,434 new shares, equal to 10% of its total post-offering share count, bringing total shares to 404,464,340; the listing matters because it gives one of China’s most visible robotics firms a public-market financing path.
